DEVELOPMENT-ONLY EXPERIMENT · NO PRODUCTION ACCESS OR PUBLICATION

Actual run: frozen DINO + base reranker

2,938 catalog cards tested against one eligible previously unqueried scan. The correct card ranked first in every frozen arm. This is not the requested50–100-photo validation and cannot establish general accuracy or production readiness. Eight other unused historical candidates failed front, exact-identity/parallel or independent-reference checks.

1eligible exact-front case
2,938indexed card IDs
2,678single-image embeddings
0verified parallel cases

What actually ran

Unchanged pinned DINO q8/CLS single-image embedding, exact all-index search, and frozen base detail reranker at top10 and top20 breadths. No new chroma. Optional ORB isolation retained its original gates and prior physical-boundary whitelist. It abstained for this case, so crop-arm input stayed byte-identical to raw.

Temporary-index breadth and limitations

3000 active DEV catalog card IDs: verified positives; up to30 exact-character hash-ordered hard negatives,15 nearby same-set numbers,all same-family same-number; remainder equal round-robin decade × metadata variant stratum, families round-robin within each stratum, SHA256 ID tie order. Public Cloudinary only. No outcome-based substitution. Failed downloads reduce actual index size.

199 main families; 889 subsets. 62 failures (61 HTTP404/unsupported-type responses;1 corrupt JPEG); no outcome-based replacements. 260 card IDs share reference digests beyond the unique count. The positive was exact-card visually verified; thousands of distractors were not individually manually audited.

Integrity, provenance and leakage

  • client/src/pages/scan.tsx confirmCard sends selectedCard.cardId as feedback before asynchronous collection mutation.
  • server/routes.ts POST /api/cards/scan persists matcher candidates/topMatchCardId; these are predictions, never labels.
  • server/routes.ts POST /api/cards/scan/:scanUploadId/feedback checks scan owner and records selectedCardId.
  • shared/schema.ts scan_feedback.scan_upload_id links feedback to scans. Historical selected IDs require same owner, nonconflicting explicit choice, and independent visual exact-front/parallel verification.
  • Feedback precedes collection save: no successful ownership inference. Timestamps alone never prove identity. Existing manual decisions remain unchanged.
  • All735 prior baseline source/data/result files remained SHA256-identical.
  • All2678 vectors finite, dimension384, unit length. Independent fresh-process single-image parity: four reference checks, cosine1, maximum component difference0.
  • Eligible query versus59 other prepared originals: minimum rotation-aware dHash distance99/256; no exact query-byte overlaps. This narrow screen is not proof against arbitrary edited/cropped copies.
  • Historical source72 predictions are not labels; only linked explicit feedback plus independent verification was eligible. Saved manual decisions were not changed.

Readiness conclusion

Insufficient evidence for general recognition or production readiness; real exact-parallel performance remains unmeasured. One base-card success does not establish exact-parallel recognition, calibration, false-high-confidence rates or performance on a representative collector population. More legitimate, previously unqueried, independently verifiable scans are still required.
